title: SKILL.md Clarifier Input
description: A request to audit or edit exactly one standalone SKILL.md or one local plugin source root containing skill contracts.

skillPath.description: The exact filesystem path to one source-of-truth SKILL.md file.

pluginRoot.description: The exact filesystem path to one local plugin source root.

target.description: Exactly one target kind. A plugin root is audited through its manifest-declared contained SKILL.md contracts.

operation.description: Audit reports findings without modifying sources; edit applies only requested, target-scoped source changes.

knownConcerns.description: Known issues or focus areas supplied by the caller; the authoritative skill still determines the complete required audit.
